description:
A music player that respects what's yours.

Noctis is a desktop music player for your local library — fast browsing,
synced lyrics, metadata editing, EQ, and more.
Discord
Download
Pick your platform from the Assets below:
────────┬──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Platform│Files
────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Windows │Noctis-v1.3.6-Setup.exe (installer) · Noctis-windows-x64.zip (portable)
────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
macOS   │Noctis-osx-arm64.dmg (Apple Silicon) · Noctis-osx-x64.dmg (Intel)
────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Linux   │Noctis-x86_64.AppImage · Noctis-linux-x64.tar.gz ·
        │Noctis-linux-arm64.tar.gz
────────┴──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
> Running on macOS — the app isn't code-signed, so Gatekeeper quarantines it on first launch. After dragging Noctis into your Applications folder, clear the flag once in Terminal:
>
> xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Noctis.app
>
> Then open Noctis normally.
What's Changed
Fixed
- Fixed Settings not persisting on restart
- Fixed profile picture flashing red
- Fixed Ratings/ReplayGain not written to WMA files
- Fixed Recycle-Bin removal splitting albums
- Fixed theme editor preview not matching real UI
- Fixed volume flyout stuck-open bug
Added
- Added Removed Tracks restore in Settings
- Added WMA/ASF format support
- Added raw AAC (ADTS) format support
- Added OGA format support
- Added flowing-light lyrics background
- Added fullscreen mode (F11 toggle)
Improved
- Improved context menu entry renamed to "Metadata"
Full Changelog: v1.3.5...v1.3.6
